'''Xer's Campaigns''', also known as the '''Cronese Wars''', were a series of military campaigns launched by the [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]] between [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]]. They allowed him to become [[King of Cron]] and conquer all the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], except the [[Livien League]].

==Prelude==
Around [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists aboard [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] had settled the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] while [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was ruled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. In the aftermath of the [[Rakatan Civil War]], the Infinite Empire was expelled or withdrew from its scattered colonies, leaving much of its technology behind to its former [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. By [[25,200 BBY]], the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Xer VIII]]'s birth, the Humans of the Tion had formed three states: the [[Kingdom of Cron]], the [[Kingdom of Barseg]], and the [[Livien League]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

Xer's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Argai]], was nominally part of the Kingdom of Cron, then centered around an [[Greater Cronese Arc|arc]] [[Lesser Cronese Arc|of]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] from [[Janilis VII]] to [[Algor]], but the distant world on the edge of the [[Indrexu Spiral|Ihala Spiral]] was routinely ignored by the royal court on [[Chandaar]].

==The campaigns==
===The Ihala Route===
{{Main|Campaign on the Ihala Route}}
Like many Argaians, Xer VIII turned to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], becoming a prominent pirate [[Pirate King/Legends|chieftain]]. Hailed the [[Lord/Legends|lord]] of Argai, he [[Battle of Dravione|seized]] [[Dravione]] and proclaimed the [[Kingdom of Argai]]. Xer moved down the [[Indrexu Route|Ihala Route]], and within a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] had [[Battle of Panna|expanded]] his kingdom to [[Panna/Legends|Panna]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

===The Kingdom of Cron===
{{Main|Campaign against the Kingdom of Cron}}
In response to the growing power of Argai, [[King of Cron]] [[Ferece]] summoned Xer to Chandaar, where he offered the pirate-lord [[Noble/Legends|noble]] titles in exchange for an oath of fealty. Offended by the offer and perceiving Ferece and his court to be weak, Xer resolved to [[Campaign against the Kingdom of Cron|conquer]] the Kingdom of Cron.<ref name="Xim Week" />

Assembling a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at Panna, Xer [[Battle of Duinarbulon|destroyed]] a [[Cronese]] fleet gathering at [[Duinarbulon]] before [[Battle of Chandaar|conquering]] Chandaar and putting Ferece to flight. Proclaimed [[King/Legends|King]] of Cron, Xer suborned the kingdom and took as hostages the heirs of those nobles and [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] he considered useful, and destroyed the families of those he did not. 

===The Cronese Sweeps===
{{Main|Cronese Sweeps}}
Xer's teenage son [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] gained a feared reputation in the [[Cronese Sweeps]], [[Battle of Pasmin|killing]] everyone in the [[Timber Palace of Pasmin|Timber Palace]] of [[Pasmin]], [[Battle of Eibon|setting]] the royal barges of [[Eibon]] adrift into the heart of the Ihala Spiral, and [[Battle of Nuswatta|razing]] the [[High Fane of Xo]] on [[Nuswatta]], converting the theocracy to Xer's service.<ref name="Xim Week" />

===The Three Allied Kingdoms===
{{Main|Campaign against the Three Allied Kingdoms}}
The Cronese Sweeps created a united, expansionist Kingdom of Cron and a battle-tested [[Navy/Legends|navy]]. Xer soon prepared to conquer beyond Cron's borders, [[Campaign against the Three Allied Kingdoms|targeting]] the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]], an alliance of [[Kingdom of Jaminere|Jaminere]], [[Kingdom of Cadinth|Cadinth]] and Barseg on his north-rimward flank. Xer moved along the [[Cadinth Run]] and [[Battle of Jaminere|conquered]] [[Battle of Cadinth (Xer's Campaigns)|the]] [[Battle of Barseg|three]] kingdoms, as well as worlds such as [[Arcan IV]], [[Corlax 4|Corlax]], and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

===The Back Spiral===
{{Main|Campaign in the Back Spiral}}
Xer then conquered beyond the Ihala Spiral. Moving from [[Algor]], he [[Campaign in the Back Spiral|moved]] north up the [[Back Spiral]], winning victories at [[Battle of Caluula (Xer's Campaigns)|Caluula]], [[Battle of Brigia (Xer's Campaigns)|Brigia]] and [[Battle of Tion|Tion]]. After the conquest, Xer built gleaming palaces on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and deeded the world to his concubines and their retainers. The world ultimately became known as "the Circlet of the Tion".<ref name="Xim Week" />

===The Livien League===
{{Main|Campaign against the Livien League}}
The Livien League, a confederation of worlds built around [[Livien]], [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] and [[Kanaver]], was the only military power in the Tion Cluster to successfully defy Xer. Xer's attempts to [[Campaign against the Livien League|move]] into the Livien League from Corlax and [[Barseg]] were [[Battle of Amarin|defeated]] at [[Amarin]], and [[Battle of Lorrad|again]] at [[Lorrad]]. In the aftermath, Xer ended his campaign against the Livien League and paused to consolidate his conquests.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Xim was born into a family of pirates some 25,000 years ago, probably on the planet Argai. He found such success following the example of his father, Xer, robbing and raiding the spacelanes that he was able to extort exorbitant sums from the merchant guilds in return for leaving their freighters unmolested. He then spent his plunder amassing an armada and army of automatons that eclipsed even the forces of the major trading magnates of the day, the Hutt clans. Once uncontested on all fronts, Xim proclaimed himself the Daritha, Cronese for "Ruler of Worlds," and his ascent to galactic despotism began.|[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]], ''[[The Despotica Reader]]'', [[The Despotica Reader, Third Edition|Third Edition]]|<ref name="Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
[[File:Xers_Empire.jpg|thumb|right|235px|Xer's Empire at the end of his conquests]]
Seeing he had overstretched himself, Xer VIII suspended his conquests and spent the remainder of his rule forging the Kingdom of Cron into an empire, extending its network of [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]] along the Back Spiral and the Cadinth Run and creating an efficient bureaucracy. Xer still harbored ambitions for the Livien League, however. He organized Cron into three provinces ruled from Chandaar, Raxus Prime and [[Cadinth]], but court rituals referred to the [[Four Thrones of Cron]]: those three worlds and the still-independent Desevro.<ref name="Xim Week" />

The Livien League would later be conquered by Xer's son and heir Xim.<ref name="Xim Week" />
